nodes.label: Mayfield Mall Saturday program listing — 'Aikido / Robert Nadeau / 1:30-2:30 P.M.' (Sep 1968)

metadata.note: Public demo program at Mayfield Mall (San Antonio Rd & Alma, Palo Alto/Mountain View area): Sitar & Tabla, Folk Dances, then 'Aikido — Robert Nadeau, 1:30-2:30 P.M.' Exhibits thru Sept 28. Covered by both Peninsula Times Tribune and Redwood City Tribune, Sep 20, 1968.

nodes.label: South Florida Sun Sentinel — Nadeau energy workshop at Florida International University (Sep 11, 1999)

metadata.note: 'Energy workshop, on integrating mind, body and spirit, by aikido master Robert Nadeau, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Sept. 19 at Florida International University, Tamiami Trail and SW 107th Avenue, Miami. ... Golden Panther Arena, Room 121. Fee: $100 in advance, $110 at the door. For information, call Aimee Bernstein at 954-630-9004.'

nodes.label: Idaho Statesman — Aikido of Idaho seminar with 'Robert Nadeau Sensei (6th Dan)' (Oct 8, 1992)

metadata.note: 'Aikido of Idaho 7-9 p.m., Oct. 9; 10 a.m.-noon, 2:30-4 p.m., 4:30-6 p.m., Oct. 10; 10 a.m.-noon, Oct. 11; 1512 N. 10th Street. A special workshop with Robert Nadeau Sensei (6th Dan). Fee: $85 for all sessions if paid by Oct. 1; $40 at the door. Information: Bill Misson 375-4596.'

nodes.label: Pacifica Tribune — Dave Bendigkeit profile, 1967 Nadeau/Mountain View origin + Ki Healing/Acupressure (Mar 7, 2001)

metadata.note: 'In 1967, Dave Bendigkeit began his training in the martial art of Aikido with Robert Nadeau Sensei. Nadeau Sensei helped to encourage his interest in the energy and healing aspects of the martial arts. Through years of study and practice with Ki Healing and Acupressure, along with Japanese and Western ...' — same profile reprinted Jul 24, 2002.
